title: Newest Android update 8.0
symptom: After updating a Samsung S7 Edge to Android 8.0 (Oreo) with Samsung Experience 9.0, replacing a Libre sensor with a BluCon transmitter fails to connect: the phone receives no initial data, never reaches calibration, and the transmitter never shows connected in xDrip, despite Bluetooth pairing working. The issue persists after clearing app cache/data and reinstalling, and the same setup works on a Samsung Note 4 with Android 6.0.1.
cause: The thread identifies the cause as a combination of Android 8.0 (Oreo) Bluetooth stack issues and the BLE module used in the BluCon (HM-10 or similar), which is incompatible with Oreo. Some users also note that the issue may be related to the xDrip version, as reverting to an older version helped.
fix: The thread suggests several workarounds: clearing Bluetooth app cache/data and reinstalling xDrip (temporary), reverting to an older xDrip version (e.g., 2018.01.22) which works with random disconnects, or using the latest nightly with OB1 collector (though not fully successful for all). The issue was marked as resolved by a maintainer after changes for Android 8.0 pairing, but no single definitive fix is stated.
settings_changed: Bluetooth app cache and data → cleared
evidence_quote: I made some changes specifically for pairing issues on Android 8.0 in the last few days, try the latest nightly and use the OB1 collector.
